        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

G=load(); print(sorted(G))

import json
d='/home/USER/runs/paper/glm-hpl0-u1-turns/frozen/held-out/play/users/u035/system/state/workspace/programs'
pairs=json.load(open(d+'/task-ea434308.json'))
pairs.append({"input":[[0,6,6,6,6]]+[[0]*5 for _ in range(5)]+[[2]*5]+[[0]*5 for _ in range(5)]+[[0,0,6,6,6]],
"output":[[0,6,6,6,6]]+[[0,0,4,4,4] for _ in range(5)]+[[2]*5]+[[0]*5 for _ in range(5)]+[[0,0,6,6,6]]})
def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    r2=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if all(x==2 for x in r)][0]
    top=[j for j in range(w) if g[0][j]!=0]
    bot=[j for j in range(w) if g[h-1][j]!=0]
    for j in set(top)&set(bot):
        for i in range(1,r2): out[i][j]=4
    return out
for p in pairs: assert transform(p['input'])==p['output']
print(json.dumps(transform([[7]*5]+[[0]*5 for _ in range(4)]+[[2]*5]+[[0]*5 for _ in range(5)]+[[0,7,7,0,0]])))
